transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Thanks for making time, Priya. Before we get into the product, tell me what made you take this call.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: We closed our Series B in March and the board wants us at forty million ARR in eighteen months. Right now our reps spend the first hour of every day fixing records by hand, and I cannot hire my way out of that.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: The number I care about is ramp time. New reps take about five months to full productivity and we have twelve people starting in Q4. If we got that to three months it is worth roughly two million in incremental bookings next year.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Who else feels that pain internally?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Marcus Vela runs revenue operations under our CFO and he owns the budget line for anything over fifty thousand dollars. I can champion this internally but Marcus signs.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: I should be straight with you, we are also looking at Clearwater. They came in through our CFO and their pitch is that everything is in one platform.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: What usually kills projects here is security review. Our process is a vendor questionnaire, then a thirty day pilot with real data, then procurement. Legal will not start until the questionnaire is back.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: What is your timeline?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: We want a decision before the end of the quarter because the new reps start in October and there is no point rolling this out mid ramp.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: One more person you should know about is Sofia Bhatt, she runs sales enablement and she will be the one deciding whether the team actually adopts it.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: So where do we go from here?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Send me the security questionnaire and I will get it to legal by the fourteenth. Let us put a joint review on the calendar for the eighteenth with Marcus in the room.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Perfect, I will send the questionnaire today.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: Before you start, I want to say the reason we are still talking is the forecast problem, not the notes problem.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: Reps rebuild the same forecast spreadsheet every Monday and by Wednesday it disagrees with the CRM.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: If the pilot does not clear security we are dead in the water, that is the whole risk.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: On commercials, where would you expect to land?

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: We would be looking at about a hundred and forty thousand for the first year, assuming the whole go to market team.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: And we would want paper signed by the end of September so it lands in this fiscal year.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: The other name that came up internally was Northstar Systems, though nobody has met with them.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: Timing beyond the pilot, maybe end of the year, honestly it is fuzzy.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: Everything goes through a security review and then Erin signs, which is me, so at least that part is quick.

transcript.speaker: Erin Salas
transcript.text: Send the pricing over to me and legal usually takes a week.

transcript.speaker: Ruben Ortiz
transcript.text: We have two things running with you at once and I am not sure which one this call is about.

transcript.speaker: Ruben Ortiz
transcript.text: The platform piece is with my team, the services piece is with finance.

transcript.speaker: Ruben Ortiz
transcript.text: Either way the thing that has to be true is that reporting stops being manual by the end of the year.

transcript.speaker: Nadia Kerr
transcript.text: Renewal is in November and my CFO has asked every vendor to justify the line item this year.

transcript.speaker: Nadia Kerr
transcript.text: We will start the renewal conversation in September so we are not doing it in the last two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Nadia Kerr
transcript.text: Honestly the team likes the product, my problem is I cannot show what it did for us.

transcript.speaker: Tom Beckett
transcript.text: We got your name from our board, we are just starting to look.

transcript.speaker: Tom Beckett
transcript.text: Right now everything lives in spreadsheets and one very tired analyst.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Quick standup, I will keep it to five minutes.

transcript.speaker: Dana Ruiz
transcript.text: Northwind is moving, Helio Grid is waiting on security.
